facts.fact: Decree No. 2023-095 of 22 March 2023, signed by the President on the digital minister's proposal, sets how the 'start-up' label is granted to micro, small and medium firms, with labelled start-ups given the tax incentives of the General Tax Code.
facts.system: Décret n° 2023-095 portant modalités d'octroi du label start-up
